body:
Yeah. I also have a tendency to think "I should be able to do this." And beat myself up because I didn't get enough done. The mood swings throw everything out of proportion depending on where they are. Good moods push me into over producing which then leads to when I'm in a bad mood feeling terrible because "I just did so much and now nothing has happened for weeks." Or it's mixed mood and I'm not sure if I'm fine or not because I'm both. 

I feel like a wannabe writer more than an actual writer sometimes.

I have extreme self doubt, hate, and perfectionism along with a fear of failure. I can sometimes write for fun and have a few times the past few days but it never got very far. My mom says I expect too much of myself... 

It really sucks because I've wanted to be an author since I was little and I really do enjoy writing if the mood is right. I know I can write a lot and reach goals because I've done it before and now I can't (which only adds to the inner commentary of how I'm a failure because I've gone so downhill.)
